{{Quote|What the&hellip;Super Star Destroyer incoming, sir!|A Zann Consortium [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] informs Tyber Zann of the ''Annihilator''{{'s}} impending arrival|audio=Annihilator-FoC.flac|<ref name="FoC" />}}
The '''''Annihilator''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaarn]] that was active shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The ''Annihilator'' was sent to pacify the forces of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]], led by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]], which had recently taken control of the partially-constructed [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']] at the Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] above [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. Joining the Imperial [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] already present, the ''Annihilator'' deployed its [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and opened fire on both the Zann Consortium forces and the ''Eclipse''. The ''Annihilator'', along with the rest of the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], was destroyed during the [[Battle for the Eclipse|battle]].

==Description==
The ''Annihilator'' was a 19-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long<ref name="Length" /> [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]]<ref name="Class" /> in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] boasted many [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]], [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] emplacements and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors. The [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was also armed with several [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers. It housed numerous [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], including [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|fighters]], [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|bombers]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|interceptors]], and [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|Defenders]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was propelled by thirteen [[Engine/Legends|engine]] units and was protected from enemy fire by [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] emitted from two [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|generator]] domes placed along the ship's command tower.<ref name="FoC" />

==History==
[[File:AnnihilatorDeath.jpg|thumb|left|The ''Annihilator''{{'s}} final moments]]
Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]] [[Battle for the Eclipse|launched an attack]] on the Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in an attempt to capture the half-constructed warship [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']]. The ''Annihilator'', under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaarn]], led a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] to assist the already thinning group of Imperial forces spread out above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The ''Annihilator'' and its fleet dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] above Kuat shortly after the ''Eclipse''{{'s}} [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], recently hijacked by Zann's forces, malfunctioned.<ref name="FoC" />

The ''Annihilator'' began assaulting the forces of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] with turbolaser and ion cannon barrages, and launched starfighter squadrons from its [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. However, the Super [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] focused its assault on its primary target, the ''Eclipse'', and attempted to destroy the massive warship before it fell into enemy hands. The combined forces of the Zann Consortium were eventually able to destroy the ''Annihilator'' and the remaining Imperial ships, allowing Zann to safely access the ''Eclipse''{{'s}} data archives.<ref name="FoC" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Annihilator'' was commanded by Admiral Gaarn shortly after the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Gaarn led the ''Annihilator'' and a fleet of three Star Destroyers to defend the Imperial shipyards above Kuat, where the entire task force was decimated by the Zann Consortium.<ref name="FoC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Annihilator'' was created for the final campaign level of the [[2006]] [[LucasArts]] real-time strategy [[Star Wars video games|video game]] expansion ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''. The ''Annihilator'' serves as the Zann Consortium campaign's final boss battle. After the player "destroys" the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the game's last level, the ''Eclipse''{{'s}} superlaser will malfunction and the ''Annihilator'' and its fleet will jump out of hyperspace, forcing the player to combat this new threat without the help of the ''Eclipse''. The player may destroy the ''Annihilator'' with their own ships, or focus their fire on the other Star Destroyers until the ''Eclipse''{{'s}} superlaser is repaired, using the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] against the ''Annihilator'' for a one-hit kill.<ref name="FoC" /> This latter tactic is recommended by [[Prima Games|Prima's]] [[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion: Prima Official Game Guide|official game guide]] for ''Forces of Corruption'', which continuously refers to the ''Annihilator'' as the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="Guide">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> However, the level will not end until all remaining Imperial ships are destroyed.<ref name="FoC" />

[[File:AnnihilatorBox.jpg|thumb|right|The only known mentions of Admiral Gaarn and the ''Annihilator''{{'s}} name]]
The ''Annihilator'' shares the same in-game model as the ''Executor'', as well as a similar weapon payload. Although there are a set number of "hard-points," various destructible emplacements vital to a ship, for each of the ''Annihilator''{{'s}} weapons, this number does not necessarily reflect the total number of such weapons emplacements present on the ship, since a considerably larger amount of weapon's fire can often be witnessed. Additionally, the ''Annihilator'' has three shield hard-points placed along its spine, only one of which is located on the dome generators. The ''Annihilator'' may deploy an unlimited number of starfighters unless the player destroys either the ship's hangar or the ship itself.<ref name="FoC" />

The only mentions of the ''Annihilator''{{'s}} name and Admiral Gaarn are contained within a single information box detailing the ship, which the player may access by placing their cursor above the ''Annihilator'' in-game. This box also lists the ''Annihilator''{{'s}} two special abilities, "Tractor Beam" and "Deploy All Squadrons," as well as the ship's strengths and weaknesses. In gameplay, the ''Annihilator'' is powerful against [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], but vulnerable against [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] squadrons.<ref name="FoC" />
